side.notes: Exact live-fish pages and FishBase proportions show the deep armored shoulder, steep taper into the peduncle, sloping head roof, short snout, flatter belly and fin placement.

top.uncertainty: Moderate to high. The osteology supplies a dorsal skull outline and FishBase notes a predorsal color patch, but no verified live whole-body orthographic top photograph was found.
top.notes: The revised half-width stations use the pyriform head-roof evidence and frontal cheek width qualitatively. They are not claimed as calibrated soft-tissue measurements.

front.notes: The exact frontal head page clearly shows embedded lateral eyes, broad armored cheeks, a flattened underside, a small transverse inferior mouth and two sizes of tapered barbels. Full-trunk frontal depth remains outside the photograph's scope.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: deep armored shoulder with a sloping head roof
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: Maximum depth is held at the pectoral-girdle shoulder while successive operculum, head and snout stations descend continuously. This replaces the rejected candidate's capsule-like forehead.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: flattened belly, short rounded snout and inferior mouth
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: A flatter ventral exponent and aligned belly stations support the resting body plan. Source-configurable upper and lower lip offsets move the small transverse mouth beneath the snout instead of leaving a circular terminal ring.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: embedded eyes and tapered maxillary and lower barbels
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: Smaller surface-seated eyes replace the failed bead-like eyes. Four tapered tube adornments replace the short ellipsoids and are rooted at the inferior mouth.

silhouetteLandmarks.name: narrow peduncle, forked caudal and strong leading fin spines
silhouetteLandmarks.notes: The posterior trunk narrows earlier, the caudal is longer and more forked, and the dorsal and pectoral leading edges receive both silhouette and procedural relief emphasis.

proportions.name: maximum adult standard length
proportions.notes: FishBase reports 7.5 cm standard length. The source records that exact scope and does not silently convert it to total length.

proportions.name: maximum body depth divided by station-defined standard length
proportions.notes: FishBase's body-height range is 1/2.9 to 1/2.5 of standard length, or about 0.345 to 0.400. The revised source is 0.366 at the deepest shoulder over the 62 mm station-defined standard length.

proportions.name: maximum body width relative to maximum body depth
proportions.uncertainty: Moderate to high. The frontal photograph covers the head, and the osteology covers the skull, but neither calibrates live whole-trunk soft-tissue width.
proportions.notes: The source is deliberately narrower than the rejected rounded candidate while retaining a robust Cory pectoral girdle. A future verified dorsal photograph can supersede this estimate.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: dark olive-bronze lateral field over a pale belly
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: A bounded trunk mask now separates the olive-bronze lateral field from the pale ventral surface instead of producing a nearly uniform beige body.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: two staggered rows of lateral armor plates
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: Two independently centered and staggered procedural rows replace generic whole-body scale relief. The plates remain normal relief rather than separate scute meshes.

colorPatternBoundaries.name: translucent yellow-amber fins with stronger leading spines
colorPatternBoundaries.notes: Fin alpha and amber color remain light while dorsal and pectoral leading edges receive darker relief cues.

mismatches.note: The preserved candidate is a generic rounded capsule with an uninterrupted domed forehead, weak peduncle taper and overly blunt head. Revised control stations retain FishBase depth at the shoulder but narrow the trunk and create a continuous head-roof slope to a smaller snout.

mismatches.area: rejected fable-v1 front and head details
mismatches.note: The preserved candidate has protruding bead eyes, a circular terminal mouth and short ellipsoid whiskers. Smaller seated eyes, independently shaped inferior lips and four tapered tube barbels address those source-level mismatches.

The preserved candidate is nearly uniform beige with generic scale relief. Species-local paint now adds a bounded olive-bronze flank, pale belly, two staggered armor rows and translucent amber fins with emphasized leading spines.

Whole-body width remains intentionally uncertain because no verified live orthographic top source was found. The narrower controls are a documented inference, not a claim of measured top-view fidelity.

failedCandidateEvidence.review: Source review found a generic rounded silhouette, protruding eyes, terminal ring mouth, non-tapered barbels and uniform beige surface. The candidate remains preserved and unpromoted.

uncertainty: No verified live whole-body orthographic top photograph was found. Trunk width is inferred conservatively from the frontal head image, dorsal skull anatomy and observed lateral depth.
pixelPolicy: No source pixels were copied, sampled, traced, hotlinked or redistributed.
